content.seo_title: W&E Health Institute | Acupuncture & Chinese Medicine in Cordova, Memphis
content.seo_description: Acupuncture, SAAT allergy treatment and Chinese herbal medicine in Cordova, TN. Two doctoral-level practitioners. VA Community Care provider. Book online.

body.headline: Chinese medicine, practiced with a physician’s care.
body.subline: Acupuncture, allergy treatment and herbal medicine in Cordova, from two doctors trained in both Eastern and Western medicine.
body.image_alt: Dried Chinese herbal roots and slices beside a glass cupping jar and a traditional herbal text

body.heading: Two doctors. Two traditions. One plan for you.
body.intro: Both are licensed acupuncturists and board-certified NCCAOM Diplomates, and each brings a different depth to your care.

doctors.name: Dr. Yingjuan (Selina) Liang
doctors.focus: Pain, women’s health & fertility, allergies, neurological conditions
credentials: Doctorate in Acupuncture & Chinese Medicine; licensed in Tennessee and Mississippi
Only overseas successor of Prof. Ying Wang, master of Modern Abdominal Acupuncture
SAAT allergy treatment, certified by Dr. Nader Soliman

doctors.name: Dr. Tieqiang Zhao
doctors.focus: Cardiac and internal medicine, chronic illness, Tai Chi & Medical Qigong
credentials: MD and PhD, Harbin Medical University; former internal medicine and cardiology attending
Former Associate Professor, Peking University Health Science Center
Board-certified Diplomate (NCCAOM), 20+ years of clinical experience
Former Principal Investigator on an NIH-funded research grant

body.heading: What we help with
body.intro: Most patients come to us for one of these. Not sure if we can help? Call and ask, we’re happy to talk it through.
body.image_alt: Glass cupping jars placed along a patient’s back during treatment

items.title: Pain
items.detail: Back, neck, joints, migraines, sciatica, old injuries

items.title: Women’s health & fertility
items.detail: Cycles, PMS, PCOS, menopause, fertility support

items.title: Heart & circulation
items.detail: Palpitations, chest tightness, functional cardiac concerns

items.title: Neurological conditions
items.detail: Neuropathy, Bell’s palsy, stroke recovery, tinnitus

body.modalities: Acupuncture, herbal medicine, cupping, moxibustion, gua sha and tui na, used alone or together.

body.heading: Allergy relief without daily medication.
body.body: Soliman Auricular Allergy Treatment (SAAT) is a gentle ear-acupuncture technique that helps your body stop over-reacting to an allergen, including Alpha-gal, food, pollen and chemical sensitivities. Both of our doctors are certified SAAT providers.
points: Know your allergen? We test for it and treat it.
Not sure what you’re reacting to? We help you screen first.
A single tiny ear needle per allergen. Most people feel little or nothing.
body.image_alt: A practitioner placing a fine needle in a patient’s ear

body.heading: Veterans: your acupuncture may cost you nothing.
body.body: We’re an authorized VA Community Care Provider. With a referral from your VA doctor, eligible Veterans can receive 12 to 28 acupuncture treatments a year at no cost to them.

steps.title: Ask your VA doctor for a referral
steps.detail: Tell your VA primary care provider you’d like acupuncture at W&E Health Institute.

steps.title: The VA sends us your authorization
steps.detail: Once it’s approved, the VA sends the authorization straight to our clinic.

steps.title: We call you to schedule
steps.detail: Our team reaches out to book your first visit.

reviews.quote: I’ve had headaches for over 5 years… Since starting acupuncture with Dr. Liang, I truly feel like I’ve gotten my life back. After only a few treatments, my headaches and sleeping problems have almost completely disappeared.
reviews.name: Mackenzie Hammons

reviews.quote: Referred to Dr. Liang for daily icepick headaches and loss of facial feeling. Acupuncture worked wonders that over 15 years of specialists and drugs could not.
reviews.name: Michael O’Driscoll

reviews.quote: Dr. Liang is highly skilled, very kind and genuinely cares for her patients. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for professional and attentive acupuncture care.
reviews.name: Lisha Wu

items.title: FSA & HSA
items.detail: Pay with your health savings or flexible spending card.

items.title: Other insurance

items.title: VA Community Care
items.detail: Usually no cost to eligible Veterans with a VA referral.

body.heading: Visit the clinic
body.body: We’re in Cordova, serving Memphis, Germantown, Bartlett and the surrounding area. Book online any time, or call us during opening hours.
